name: Quest Lodge: cross-wing and reading bay
subtitle: Bible silhouette reference / actual in-app Blender study
review_note: Unequal volumes, masonry, timber framing and projecting bay read clearly. Original wood grain is too broad; roof fields remain regular. No island-context acceptance.
improve: Plank-scale wood grain, stronger roof character, measured stair routes, active hearth and integrated guide/services.
